name: How long does a walk-in shower installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a walk-in shower installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard walk-in shower installation can take anywhere from 3-7 days, depending on the complexity of the project. This timeline includes demolition of the old shower, any necessary plumbing rough-ins, waterproofing, tiling, and fixture installation. Projects requiring custom pan creation, extensive tile work, or structural alterations may extend the duration. Hometelligent Inc. will provide a project timeline during the consultation based on your specific requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 3-7 days, but complex projects with custom features or extensive tiling may require more time.
